prompt: Camera backing away in front of him at chest height, 28mm, down a steel vault corridor in the 1920s. A sweating stocky Puerto Rican man of about 38, round face, thick eyebrows, stubble, wet black hair, shirt open under dark braces, leans into a wooden wheelbarrow low in the frame, heaped with plain gold bars, his face a third of the frame height, front-on, singing between breaths. Behind him the corridor runs to a round open vault door. Red alarm light pulses on riveted walls from behind. Cold steel-blue caged bulbs overhead light his face, and the gold bounces warmth up under his chin. The gold is unmarked. The picture runs edge to edge. Thanks.
